description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform JSON relay family. Covers FDR/Event Streams-style endpoint rows plus separate conservative platform-module variants for Devices API, Spotlight API-resource, Intelligence indicator/feed API records, Event Streams audit/RTR session records, and selected sample-backed identity/protection/detection/policy records.

source_log_version.name: CrowdStrike Falcon Platform JSON relay records
source_log_version.notes: Umbrella Falcon Platform pack grounded in public Elastic CrowdStrike FDR/API integration samples, official CrowdStrike Developer Center/FalconPy endpoint evidence, and synthetic-equivalent fixtures. FDR/Event Streams endpoint rows, Devices API host inventory resources, and Spotlight vulnerability API resources are implemented as separate source-mode variants. Event Streams audit/auth/user activity and RTR session rows are implemented from public sample-backed structures; Identity Protection and selected detection/policy/response variants are implemented from public sample-backed structures; Intelligence indicator/feed API records are implemented as conservative API/feed relay fixtures, not native Event Streams proof. Collector wrapping must be validated locally.

pack_variants.label: Falcon FDR JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Default variant for FDR/Event Streams-style relays that preserve one CrowdStrike JSON object per event and the event_simpleName token.
known_limitations: No live Falcon relay replay/read-back captured.

Devices API inventory, Spotlight vulnerability API resources, Intelligence indicator/feed API records, Event Streams audit/auth/user activity/RTR session rows, Identity Protection, selected detection/response summaries, and firewall policy-match records are implemented as separate source-mode variants where public sample-backed evidence exists.

RTR command/action rows, admin policy-change audit rows, native streaming proof for API-feed modules, and Intelligence report events remain blocked without exact public samples/schemas or sanitized source evidence.

pack_variants.label: Falcon Devices API host inventory relay
pack_variants.description: Conservative API-resource relay variant for host inventory records from CrowdStrike Devices/Hosts APIs. Treat as collector/API output, not native FDR telemetry.
known_limitations: No native FDR/Event Streams proof for Devices API records; treat as API/collector relay records.
No live Falcon API relay replay/read-back captured.

pack_variants.label: Falcon Spotlight vulnerability API relay
pack_variants.description: Conservative API-resource relay variant for Spotlight vulnerability records carrying vulnerability, CVE, host, application, and remediation context. Treat as collector/API output, not native FDR telemetry.
known_limitations: No native FDR/Event Streams proof for Spotlight API records; treat as API/collector relay records.
No live Falcon Spotlight relay replay/read-back captured.

pack_variants.label: Falcon Event Streams audit, RTR, identity, detection, and policy relay
pack_variants.description: Conservative Event Streams relay variant for sample-backed AuthActivityAuditEvent, UserActivityAuditEvent, RemoteResponseSessionStart/End, Identity Protection, selected detection/response summary, and firewall policy-match records. It does not cover RTR command/action rows or admin policy-change audit rows.
known_limitations: No live Falcon Event Streams relay replay/read-back captured.
RTR command/action rows and admin policy-change audit rows remain out of scope until exact public samples/schemas or sanitized source evidence are selected.

pack_variants.label: Falcon Intelligence indicator/feed API relay
pack_variants.description: Conservative API/feed relay variant for Falcon Intelligence indicator records carrying observable, actor, malware, kill-chain, confidence, tag, target, and vulnerability context. Treat as API/feed output, not native FDR/Event Streams telemetry.
known_limitations: No native FDR/Event Streams proof for Intelligence API/feed records; treat as API/collector relay records.
No live Falcon Intelligence relay replay/read-back captured.
Intelligence report emitted events remain blocked unless a specific public API/feed report shape is selected.

cribl.notes: Use after sampling the local Falcon feed. Do not drop command line, file hash/path, network tuple, DNS query, sensor state, or device/tenant context by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

validation_commands: Start Data Prepper with the generated pipelines.yaml in a disposable test container and confirm pipeline startup before replay/read-back.
data_prepper.notes: Data Prepper support is recorded as a conservative OpenSearch ingestion pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Data Prepper pipeline artifact is generated by this pack yet.

opensearch_dashboards.config_model: index pattern/data view -> saved objects NDJSON -> dashboard/visualizations
validation_commands: Import exported NDJSON into a disposable OpenSearch Dashboards space and confirm data view/index-pattern resolution.
opensearch_dashboards.notes: OpenSearch Dashboards support is recorded as visualization-target metadata only. Splunk dashboards, where present, have not been automatically translated to OpenSearch saved objects or live-tested.

known_limitations: Pack ID remains crowdstrike_falcon for download/source compatibility, but the display/source identity is CrowdStrike Falcon Platform because the pack covers multiple Falcon platform modules rather than a single Falcon product surface.
No live Falcon relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real tenant records.
SC4S emits pack-defined family sourcetypes; exact collector wrapping/source names need local comparison.

Devices API inventory, Spotlight vulnerability API resources, and Intelligence indicator/feed API records are implemented as conservative API/collector relay variants, not native FDR/Event Streams proof; Event Streams audit/auth/user activity, RTR session, Identity Protection, selected detection/response summary, and firewall policy-match rows are implemented from public sample-backed structures.

RTR command/action rows, admin policy-change audit rows, native streaming proof for API-feed modules, and Intelligence report events remain blocked without exact public samples/schemas or sanitized source evidence.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
